Methodological_Notes.Lead_Duration: Measures early warning runway (consecutive Medium-risk states before High-risk escalation); does not represent physical breakdown time as dataset contains no failure ground-truth labels.
Methodological_Notes.Downtime_Prevention_Index_Proxy: Calculated as ratio of High-risk anomalies preceded by an early Medium warning (33.4%). Represents theoretical pre-warning coverage, NOT measured downtime prevention, as no breakdown or downtime logs exist in the data.
Methodological_Notes.Recovery_Success_Rate: Fraction of maintenance episodes (4490/8895) where mean Anomaly_Score in the 5 records immediately after maintenance is strictly less than mean Anomaly_Score in the 5 records immediately before maintenance. Criterion is purely data-derived; no failure ground-truth labels are used.
